user.title: Bestiarium Mock Devices
user.description:
This will create mock devices for testing purposes:

- Mock Grid (power monitoring with alarm)
- Mock Boiler, AC, Router, Kettle, Heating, Fridge (fixed power)
- Mock Cooker, Washing Machine, Dishwasher (variable power)
- 4 Mock Smart Sockets (600W fixed power)
- 4 Mock Thermometers (temperature sensors with manual input)

Each device includes a switch, power sensor, and mock behavior controls.

abort.already_configured: Mock devices are already configured. Only one instance is allowed.
